name: BOLD
description: Bias in Open-ended Language Generation Dataset is a benchmark for measuring fairness and bias in open-ended text generation. Contains 23,679 English Wikipedia prompts spanning 5 domains: profession, gender, race, religion, and political ideology.
reputation: Standard fairness benchmark for generative models; introduced by Amazon; widely used in bias evaluation of LLMs
notes: Prompts are entity-centric, starting with a Wikipedia entity. Measures sentiment and toxicity disparities across demographic groups. Part of standard LLM bias evaluation suites.
